Zip a directory into a zip file

Usage:
  ycy zip [directory] [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help              help for zip
  -d, --with-dir string   Include the directory name as a top-level folder in the zip
  -w, --without-open      Do not open the zip file after creation

Global Flags:
      --log-format string   Diagnostic format: text or json
      --log-level string    Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
      --quiet               Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose             Enable debug diagnostics
